Name: Birthday Lineup - NPC Birthday Showcase
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[quote][center][color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Overview [/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote]Ever installed a bunch of NPC expansions only to realize multiple villagers share the exact same birthday—and the vanilla calendar only shows one of them?
[b][color=#00ffff]Birthday Lineup[/color][/b] solves this by bringing everyone into the spotlight! Instead of hiding overlapping birthdays, this mod introduces a lively, animated character lineup directly on Stardew Valley's vanilla calendar. Watch villagers smoothly take turns stepping forward, cycle through them effortlessly, and never miss a chance to give a birthday gift again—all while keeping the classic look and feel of the vanilla UI intact.
[img width=875]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55919/55919-1795409581-970345321.gif[/img]
[quote][center][color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Key Features [/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][*][b][color=#00ffff]Multi-Birthday Showcase:[/color][/b] Displays up to [b]4 NPCs at once[/b] on shared birthdays. Have even more? Additional characters are seamlessly queued and rotated in so no one gets left out.[/*]
[*][color=#00ffff][b]Vanilla-First Priority:[/b] [/color]Keeps things familiar by featuring vanilla villagers at the front of the lineup, followed smoothly by your modded NPCs.[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Fluid Animations:[/color][/b] Inspired by classic character lineup edits, NPCs slide into view with polished, staggered movements and subtle fade effects.[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Synchronized Auto-Cycling:[/color][/b] Lineups automatically advance at a steady, synchronized rhythm across the calendar so you can browse hands-free.[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Interactive Controls:[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Click to Advance:[/color][/b] Impatient? Click any lineup to immediately trigger the next transition (rapid clicks are smartly queued in order).[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Hover to Pause:[/color][/b] Simply hover your cursor over a lineup to freeze it in place while you check who's celebrating. Move away, and it seamlessly syncs back into the rhythm.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]100% Vanilla Aesthetic:[/color][/b] Uses existing game sprites and calendar assets—zero jarring custom art, ensuring seamless visual harmony with your game (and any UI recolors).[/*]
[*][b][color=#00ffff]Full GMCM Support:[/color][/b] Tweak animation speeds, NPC spacing, background dimming, and interaction behaviors on the fly via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].
[quote][center][color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Comic Sans MS] FAQ [/font][/size][/color][/center]
[/quote][spoiler][b][color=#ff7700]Q: Does this mod add new NPCs or change existing birthday dates?[/color][/b]
No. Birthday Lineup is purely a visual and quality-of-life enhancement. It doesn't add characters or alter schedules—it simply displays all the birthdays already registered on your calendar.
[b][color=#ff7700]Q: Will it work with my modded NPCs (like SVE, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, etc.)?[/color][/b]
Yes! Any custom NPC whose birthday is recognized by the vanilla calendar will automatically appear in the lineup.
[b][color=#ff7700]Q: Why is the display capped at 4 NPCs at a time?[/color][/b]
To keep the calendar clean, readable, and clutter-free. If 5 or more villagers share a birthday, the rest wait in a smart queue and cycle into view automatically (or whenever you click!).
[b][color=#ff7700]Q: Is Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) required?[/color][/b]
Nope! GMCM is completely optional. The mod works great right out of the box with its default settings.
[b][color=#ff7700]Q: Does this replace the vanilla calendar UI?[/color][/b]
Not at all. It hooks cleanly into the existing calendar, making it 100% compatible with most UI mods and recolors.
[color=#ff7700][b]Q: Was Birthday Lineup inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48314]Birthday Rolodex?[/url][/b][/color]
Yes! [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48314][b]Birthday Rolodex[/b][/url][/i] by[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ichortower]ichortower[/url][/b] served as a key inspiration and reference point for this project, sparking the idea of displaying multiple shared birthdays in a rotating lineup.
Building on that concept, [b][color=#00ffff]Birthday Lineup[/color][/b] takes things in its own direction with sequential showcase animations, synchronized auto-cycling, and interactive click-and-hover controls.
A huge thank you to ichortower for the original idea—be sure to check out [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48314][b]Birthday Rolodex[/b][/url][/i]  as well![/spoiler]
